name: SHA-512 Hash Generator
description: Generate the SHA-512 hash of any text instantly using your browser's built-in Web Crypto API — a wider digest than SHA-256 for extra collision margin.

faq.question: SHA-256 vs. SHA-512 — which should I use?
faq.answer: Both are currently secure with no known practical attacks. SHA-512 produces a wider 512-bit digest and, on 64-bit hardware, is often computed faster than SHA-256 despite being larger, since it works on 64-bit words natively. SHA-256 remains more common simply by convention (e.g. most TLS certificates). Either is a reasonable default for new work.

faq.question: How is this computed?
faq.answer: Via your browser's native Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle.digest) — the same implementation your browser uses for TLS internally, not a hand-rolled reimplementation.
